info.name: Memberful GraphQL API
info.description: Memberful is a Patreon-owned membership and subscription platform. It exposes a single GraphQL endpoint per account at POST https://{{account}}.memberful.com/api/graphql, authenticated with an API key as a bearer token (or an OAuth 2.0 access token). Requests POST a GraphQL `query` (query or mutation). Errors are returned as HTTP 200 with an `errors` array. Set the `account` variable to your Memberful subdomain and `apiKey` to a Custom Application key. Queries below are honestly modeled from Memberful's public docs and GraphQL API Explorer; verify field names against the live Explorer.

request.description: Retrieve a single member with their subscriptions.
Create a new member (documented example mutation).
Retrieve a single subscription with its plan and member.
List passes (dashboard "Plans") and the pricing plans within each.
List all plans (pricing options) across passes.
List orders (transaction records) with cursor-based pagination.
